Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Join activities to assays on assay ID, join activities to target dictionary on target ID, and join activities to molecule dictionary and compound structures on molecule registry number. Filter for target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1075102, standard type IC50, exact standard relation equals, and non-null pChEMBL value. Order by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows.
